name: io.github.PacketSnifferHK/maplewatch-mcp
title: maplewatch
description: Unofficial: checks Canadian Cyber Centre security advisories against the software you run (EN/FR).

environmentVariables.name: MAPLEWATCH_STACK
environmentVariables.description: Path to a stack.yaml listing the software you run and its versions

environmentVariables.name: MAPLEWATCH_SBOM
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated paths to CycloneDX JSON SBOM files

environmentVariables.name: MAPLEWATCH_DOCKER
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to read running Docker containers (read-only GET requests)

environmentVariables.name: DOCKER_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Docker endpoint: unix socket or a read-only socket proxy (tcp://host:2375)
